style: Celtic hard trance at 145 BPM in a minor mode, hard sawtooth synths, 303, pounding four-on-the-floor kick, distorted 303-style bass, and wide supersaw chords beneath Uilleann-pipe leads, tin whistle ornaments, bodhrán rolls, and clattering Celtic frame percussion, Gated vocal layers, cavernous reverb, rainlike delays, and tense breakdowns heighten isolation before forceful drops, female vocals, powerful bass, epic breaks, folk violin, uplifting trance, atmospheric trance, bagpipes echoing, instrument-forward mix, vocals low in the mix, subdued vocals
lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
I’m standing in a crowd of a thousand faces
But I can’t find a single soul I know
The spotlight hits the floor in empty spaces
And I’ve got nowhere left for me to go

[chorus]
Left behind
Trying to keep my head above the tide
I’m so alone tonight
Left behind
Nowhere left to run and nowhere to hide
I’m so alone tonight

[verse]
The speakers hum a song I can’t remember
The lyrics fall like rain against the glass
I gave my best from June until December

[chorus]
Left behind
Trying to keep my head above the tide
I’m so alone tonight
Left behind
Nowhere left to run and nowhere to hide
I’m so alone tonight

[bridge]
The amps are screaming out a name
But every note just feels the same
I’m reaching for a hand to hold
In a room that’s turned so cold

[chorus]
Left behind
Trying to keep my head above the tide
I’m so alone tonight
Left behind
Nowhere left to run and nowhere to hide
I’m so alone tonight

[outro]
